name: 项目预算关联查询
description: 实现项目总预算与预算应用的关联比对
statement: SELECT p.project_no, p.project_name, p.total_budget, b.budget_no, b.total_amount, b.executed_amount FROM 项目主表 p LEFT JOIN 预算主表 b ON p.project_no = b.project_no
